title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Goodwill Percentage, Cap, Yearly Quota and Request Window
content:
Commercial goodwill on a Demurrage and Detention Free Time invoice is bounded by four figures that each product sets for itself.

- **Percentage** — the largest goodwill waiver, expressed in whole percent of the amount on the invoice against which goodwill is measured.
- **Money cap** — the largest goodwill waiver on one invoice, in US dollars.
- **Yearly quota** — how many goodwill waivers a single customer can hold over any trailing 365-day period.
- **Request window** — how long, in calendar days reckoned from its date, an invoice stays open to a goodwill request.

| Product | Percentage | Money cap per invoice | Quota per 365 days | Request window |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 30 days |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 10 | 250.00 | 1 | 30 days |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 10 | 350.00 | 1 | 30 days |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 15 | 500.00 | 2 | 45 days |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 15 | 750.00 | 2 | 45 days |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 25 | 1500.00 | 4 | 60 days |

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Is there any goodwill allowance on the tariff product?**
The tariff product's percentage, money cap and quota are all 0.

**Q: Two products share a percentage — do they share a cap?**
No. AHL Free Time Extension 3 and AHL Free Time Extension 7 both allow 10 percent but cap it at 250.00 and 350.00 respectively; the two combined products both allow 15 percent with caps of 500.00 and 750.00.
